name: Shareyourpaper.org
tagline: Simplest way to legally make academic papers freely available on Google Scholar, Web of Science, and personal sites
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on third-party data sources (Crossref, Microsoft Academic, Unpaywall, Europe PMC, Open Access Button)
contributor_governance: open contribution model with GitHub-based collaboration

scraped.scraped_description: We can help you make your paper Open Access, for free, wherever you publish. It’s legal and takes just minutes. Join millions of researchers sharing their papers freely with colleagues and the public.

political_relevance_summary: Shareyourpaper.org addresses civic data access and transparency. Simplest way to legally make academic papers freely available on Google Scholar, Web of Science, and personal sites.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides digital rights infrastructure or privacy-preserving technology foundations.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication; already deployed across multiple jurisdictions.
